name: Planitop Raso Max
classification: EN 1504-3 R2, EN 1504-1 PCC, EN 998-1 GP CS IV
description: Planitop Raso Max is a one component, fibre reinforced, water repellent lime cement smoothing and levelling mortar laid 2 to 10 mm thick over concrete, cementitious render, old quartz paint and scratch effect plastic coatings. It is extra white, with aggregate no larger than 0.6 mm, so it is a skim coat that is finished with a damp sponge float and then painted, not a bed for tiling. That is the line between it and Planitop Fast 330, the other levelling mortar we stock: Fast 330 is grey, works 3 to 30 mm and takes ceramic after 4 hours, while Raso Max wants 7 days before a Silexcolor, Silancolor, Elastocolor, Quarzolite, Colorite or Dursilite finish goes over it. Consumption is approximately 1.45 kg per square metre per millimetre. Mix a 25 kg bag with 5.5 to 6.0 litres of water; pot life is about 1 hour at 20 degrees.
meta_description: Planitop Raso Max: white fibre reinforced lime cement skim mortar, 2 to 10 mm at 1.45 kg/m2 per mm. Request the data sheet from Lapiz Blue UAE.

specs.classification: EN 1504-3 R2, EN 1504-1 PCC, EN 998-1 GP CS IV
specs.coverage: Approximately 1.45 kg/m² per mm of thickness.
specs.mixing_ratio: 100 kg of Planitop Raso Max with 22 to 24 kg of water, which is 5.5 to 6.0 litres to a 25 kg bag
specs.application_temperature: surrounding and substrate temperature from +5°C to +35°C
specs.compressive_strength: 3 MPa at 1 day, 12 MPa at 7 days, 16 MPa at 28 days
specs.recoat_time: 7 days before painting with a product from the Silexcolor, Silancolor, Elastocolor, Quarzolite, Colorite or Dursilite ranges
specs.storage_shelf_life: 12 months in its original packaging in a dry area

applications: Levelling and finishing concrete and strong cementitious render before painting
Smoothing walls over sound washable acrylic paints, quartz paints and plastic coatings
Smoothing and levelling plasterboard panels previously treated with Primer G
Smoothing and levelling internal glass coatings previously treated with Eco Prim Grip Plus
Fine textured skim coats on internal and external concrete and cementitious render
